# DisplayCove 1.0.0 Unsigned Preview 1
This technical preview creates viewer-friendly virtual displays for controlled screen sharing.
- 1920 × 1080 and other common HiDPI resolutions - Multiple independent virtual displays - H.264 and HEVC recording with optional system and microphone audio - Guided first launch and Sparkle update checks
This build is self-signed and not notarized. macOS requires manual approval through System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway on first launch.
